clusters.label: Time/Motion Notes (Physics IV)
clusters.content_summary: Detailed working notes on chronos, kinesis, the 'now' (nun) as boundary, and the soul-time question. More granular than A's sec. 1.2 treatment.
clusters.unique_material: Extended nun analysis, asymmetry of dependence argument worked through in detail

clusters.label: Phantasia vs Judgment / Taking-As
clusters.content_summary: Working notes on the distinction between phantasia's 'seeming' and judgment's 'asserting.' Explores whether taking-as is a phantasia function or a doxa function.
clusters.unique_material: The question 'is taking-as phantasia or doxa?' posed explicitly — A's polished text treats it as phantasia but the notes show authorial uncertainty

clusters.label: Pathos / Affective Motion / Emotion Definitions
clusters.content_summary: Working notes on whether pathos = affective motion. Explores the question 'Does pathos = affective motion' explicitly. Connects to e-motion etymology.
clusters.unique_material: Explicit question 'Does pathos = affective motion' — indicates this identification was not yet settled when notes were written

clusters.label: The Resolution (Phantasia as Appearance vs Faculty)
clusters.content_summary: Key passage addressing Tension #1: phantasia as phenomenal appearance vs cognitive faculty. The resolution: phantasia is BOTH — it is the faculty that produces appearances, and those appearances are the mode in which the world shows up.
clusters.unique_material: Explicit resolution of the appearance/faculty tension — A uses both senses but doesn't explicitly resolve the tension

clusters.label: Phantasia Reconceived Ontologically (Key Thesis Note)
clusters.content_summary: 'phantasia, reconceived ontologically... can be understood as a structural condition of Dasein's temporality, situated between affectedness and projection.' This is the thesis connecting Ch 1 and Ch 2.
clusters.unique_material: The formulation 'structural condition of Dasein's temporality, situated between affectedness and projection' — more precise than A's formulations

clusters.label: Heidegger Mood Bridge Ideas
clusters.content_summary: Notes exploring whether Stimmung can 'subsume' phantasia. Includes the question 'need to articulate why/how retaining Aristotle's phantasia as complementary to Heidegger's mood is beneficial.'
clusters.unique_material: The complementarity question is posed more openly here than in A's resolved subsumption thesis — reveals authorial deliberation

clusters.label: RDR2 / Game Analysis Hooks
clusters.content_summary: Notes connecting phantasia to video game perception/action loops. Red Dead Redemption 2 as case study for habituated phantasia in virtual environments.
clusters.unique_material: Game analysis hooks for potential later chapters — not developed in A

clusters.label: The Phantasia KEY
clusters.content_summary: 'Fills in the gaps to create a cohesive experience.' A one-line formulation of phantasia's core function.
clusters.unique_material: Pithy formulation not present in A's more elaborate prose

clusters.label: Meta-Notes and Directives
clusters.content_summary: Various 'need to...' and 'don't include this...' and 'what do we lose by...' notes scattered throughout. Reveal authorial priorities and uncertainties.
